title: Reflective lattices and hyperkahler manifolds
summary: Using the results of Nikulin and Vinberg on the groups of isometries generated by reflections, we construct a subvariety called the Nikulin-Vinberg locus in the moduli space of polarized hyperkahler manifolds. It is obtained as a finite union of components of higher Noether-Lefschetz loci which parameterize manifolds with certain special Neron-Severi lattices. The Nikulin-Vinberg locus is the closure of the set of hyperkahler manifolds with Picard number $\geq 3$ which have finite groups of birational automorphisms.
